description: A decider a host knows (baudelib/deciders.py): a server that answers Strands Decider's System One API (POST /v1/systemone, GET /health), as the deciders op lists it, and as a member's record says it (no url). What a task's decider variable binds, and what decide's decider names, is its value.

value.description: What decide's decider names it as, on the host that listed it: its id for one of that host's own, <its host's name>/<its id> for another member's.

host.description: The member that has it, by its id (the listing host's own: null).

url.description: Where it's served (the listing host's own only).

reachable.description: It answered as a decider when it was last looked at: a variable bound to one that didn't is warned of before a run.

model.description: The model it serves, as its /health says.
